scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('dist/ cleaned.');"
scripts.kill-ports: powershell -Command "8085,9099,5000,5001,4000 | ForEach-Object { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { $c | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force }; Write-Host \"Killed process on port $_\" } else { Write-Host \"Port $_ is free\" } }"
scripts.dev: npm run kill-ports && concurrently -k -n fn-watch,front-watch,emulators -c yellow,blue,green "npm --prefix functions run build:watch" "npm run watch:fast" "firebase emulators:start --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit=./.emulator-data"
scripts.dev:livereload: npm run kill-ports && concurrently -k -n fn-watch,front-watch,emulators -c yellow,blue,green "npm --prefix functions run build:watch" "npm run watch" "firebase emulators:start --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit=./.emulator-data"
